tools.name: umami_event_stats
tools.title: Umami Event Stats
tools.description: Get custom event totals (events, visitors, visits, distinct names) for a website and range, with a comparison period.

websiteId.description: Website ID from umami_websites_list. Defaults to UMAMI_DEFAULT_WEBSITE_ID.

startAt.description: Start of the range in epoch milliseconds.

endAt.description: End of the range in epoch milliseconds. Defaults to now.

filters.description: Optional analytics filters; include only keys to filter on. Keys: path, referrer, title, query, hostname, event, tag, browser, os, device, country, region, city, language, distinctId, utmSource, utmMedium, utmCampaign, utmContent, utmTerm, segment, cohort, match. Values are exact matches by default; prefix a value with neq., c., dnc., re. or nre. for not-equals, contains, does-not-contain, regex or not-regex, and comma-separate several exact values. segment and cohort take saved IDs from umami_segments_list; match is all (default) or any.

filters.description: Optional analytics filters; include only keys to filter on. tools.name: umami_funnel_run
tools.title: Umami Funnel Run
tools.description: Calculate conversion through a saved funnel (funnelId) or ad-hoc ordered steps (2 to 8).

websiteId.description: Website ID from umami_websites_list. Defaults to UMAMI_DEFAULT_WEBSITE_ID.

startAt.description: Start of the range in epoch milliseconds.

endAt.description: End of the range in epoch milliseconds. Defaults to now.

funnelId.description: ID of a saved funnel from umami_funnels_list. Give either funnelId or steps.

steps.description: Ordered funnel steps (2 to 8). Give either funnelId or steps.

type.description: path for a page path, event for a custom event name.

value.description: The page path or event name. Use * as a wildcard.

windowMinutes.description: Maximum minutes between the first and each following step (default 60). Ignored with funnelId.

filters.description: Optional analytics filters; include only keys to filter on. Keys: path, referrer, title, query, hostname, event, tag, browser, os, device, country, region, city, language, distinctId, utmSource, utmMedium, utmCampaign, utmContent, utmTerm, segment, cohort, match. Values are exact matches by default; prefix a value with neq., c., dnc., re. or nre. for not-equals, contains, does-not-contain, regex or not-regex, and comma-separate several exact values. segment and cohort take saved IDs from umami_segments_list; match is all (default) or any.
